Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare

 c_usps_id donor_addresses.usps_id%type;
 c_dob donors.date_of_birth%type;
 c_abo varchar2(5);
 other_propr1 number :=0; 
 other_propr2 number :=0; 
 chk_all number :=0;
 v_flag varchar2(1);
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_time1 date;
 v_local_date varchar2(25);
 v_local_date1 date;
 v_str varchar2(2000);
 v_str1 varchar2(2000);
begin
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then 
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 
 v_local_date := to_char(v_local_time,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 
 else
 --v_local_date := trunc(sysdate);
 v_local_date := to_char(sysdate,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 
 end if;
 

 if :global.action='CANCEL' then
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;

 :ctrl_blk.donor_id := :global.donor_id;
 
 SELECT NVL (intl_addr_flag, 'N')
 INTO v_flag
 FROM donor_addresses da
 WHERE donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id;
 /* populate name,date of birth , ssn ,sex*/
 select ltrim(rtrim(last_name))||', '||ltrim(rtrim(first_name))||' '||
 ltrim(rtrim(middle_name)),
 date_of_birth,
 decode(gender,'M','Male','F','Female'),
 nvl(blood_type,'NONE')
 into :ctrl_blk.name,
 c_dob,
 :ctrl_blk.sex,
 c_abo
 from donors
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id;
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 
 :ctrl_blk.date_of_birth := to_char(c_dob,'mm-dd-yyyy');

 /* populate street , suite/apartment */
begin
 If v_flag='N' then
 select street_name,
 suite_apt,
 usps_id
 into :ctrl_blk.street_name,
 :ctrl_blk.suite_apt,
 c_usps_id 
 from donor_addresses
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id;
 Elsif v_flag='Y' then
 SELECT d.last_name, d.first_name, 
 d.date_of_birth, d.gender,
 da.intl_address_1||decode(da.intl_address_2,nvl(da.intl_address_2,0),',',null)||' '||
 da.intl_address_2||decode(da.intl_address_3,nvl(da.intl_address_3,0),',',null)||' '||
 da.intl_address_3||decode(da.intl_address_4,nvl(da.intl_address_4,0),',',null)||' '||
 da.intl_address_4||decode(country_name,nvl(country_name,0),',',null)||' '||
 COUNTRY_NAME||decode(intl_postal_code,nvl(intl_postal_code,0),',',null)||' '||INTL_POSTAL_CODE as international_addresses
 INTO :GLOBAL.last_name, :GLOBAL.first_name, :GLOBAL.dob,:GLOBAL.s_sex,:global.s_address1
 FROM donors d, donor_addresses da 
 WHERE d.donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 AND d.donor_id = da.donor_id;
 :ctrl_blk.intl_addr:=:global.s_address1;
 End if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11212');
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 /* populate city,state,zip */

 begin
 If v_flag='N' then
 select zip,
 city,
 state
 into :ctrl_blk.zip,
 :ctrl_blk.city,
 :ctrl_blk.state
 from valid_city_state
 where usps_id = c_usps_id;
 Else 
 null;
 End if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message('City,zip,state Missing for the donor-'||:ctrl_blk.donor_id);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 /* Select the blood type description from valid master codes */
 
 begin 
 select substr(description,1,20)
 into :ctrl_blk.blood_type
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='ABO'
 and code=c_abo;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11040'); /* Invalid blood type */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 /* other properties which are not part of the classes of the current user */

 begin
 select distinct 1
 into chk_all
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='PROPR'
 --and access_code_value ='ALL'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1))
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 chk_all :=0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 if chk_all=1 then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into :ctrl_blk.other_propr
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code in (select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1)
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type='PROPR'
 --and b.access_code_value='ALL'
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1)
 and c.inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 and c.view_level>a.inter_level
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1);
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 

 else
 /* Calculate the no of interdictions which doesn't belong to the
 users access classes */
 begin
 select count(*)
 into other_propr1
 from donor_interdictions 
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code not in (select access_code_value 
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='PROPR' 
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class
 from valid_user_access_classes 
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1))
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1); 

 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 /*Calculate the no of interdictions placed on the donor but he user
 doesn't have access to remove */
 begin
 select count(*)
 into other_propr2
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code in (select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1)
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type='PROPR'
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1)
 and b.access_code_value=c.inter_code
 and c.view_level>a.inter_level
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')+1);
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk.other_propr := other_propr1+other_propr2;
 end if; 

 
 /* poplate existing interdictions and go to new_inter_blk to 
 enable the user to enter new interdictions */

 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 clear_block;
 execute_query;

exception when others then
 handle_error; 
end;

begin
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then

 else

 if :exist_inter_blk.term_date is not null then

end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY

declare
chk_all number :=0;
v_local_time date;
v_local_time1 date;
v_local_date varchar2(25);
v_local_date1 date;
v_str varchar2(2000);
v_str1 varchar2(2000);
begin
 /* set the donor id */
 
 :exist_inter_blk.donor_id := :ctrl_blk.donor_id;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then 
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 
 v_local_date := to_char(v_local_time,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 
 else
 --v_local_date := trunc(sysdate);

 /* set the chapter id */

 /* Check whether the user has ALL access level */

 when others then
 -- message('others'||' '||sqlerrm);pause;
 handle_error;
 end;
 

 
 if chk_all = 1 then
 /* set_block_property('exist_inter_blk',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and trunc(sysdate)!=trunc(nvl(term_date,sysdate-1))
 and inter_type in (select code

 'and inter_type '||'in (select code from valid_master_codes where code_type=''PROPR'') and inter_code '||'in ( select c.inter_code from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b, valid_user_access_classes a where a.user_id=:banner.user_id '||

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 descr varchar2(50);
 --v_local_time date;
 --v_local_term_date date;
 --v_local_date date;
 chp_sysdate date;
 
 cursor c1 (p_local_date in date) is
 select inter_code,
 inter_type,
 eff_date,
 term_date,
 insert_user,
 release_user
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 and term_date < p_local_date --trunc(p_local_date) ; Modified on 05/26/2011; AV; 
 order by eff_date desc ;
 

begin

 if :global.action='CANCEL' then
 exit_form(NO_VALIDATE);
 end if;
 
 /* set insert allowed * delete allowed properties true to enable to
 insert the data */

 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 go_block('term_inter_blk');
 
 -- Added on 05/26/2011; old code commented below;
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 ---
 /* commented by AV on 05/26/2011 and added above code.
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(SYSDATE,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 
 v_local_date := trunc(to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'mm-dd-yyyy HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI'));
 
 else
 v_local_date :=to_date(to_char(SYSDATE,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 */ 
 /* populate the block with terminated interdicions */

 for z in c1(chp_sysdate)
 loop
 select inter_desc
 into descr
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code=z.inter_code; 

 /* if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(SYSDATE,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 
 v_local_term_date := trunc(to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'mm-dd-yyyy HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI'));
 
 else
 v_local_term_date :=to_date(to_char(SYSDATE,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;*/
 :term_inter_blk.inter_code := z.inter_code;
 :term_inter_blk.descrip := descr;
 :term_inter_blk.eff_date := to_char(z.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 :term_inter_blk.term_date := z.term_date;--to_char(v_local_term_date,'MM-DD-YYYY');
 :term_inter_blk.insert_user := z.insert_user;
 :term_inter_blk.release_user := z.release_user;
 next_record;
 end loop;

 /* delete the blank record created at the end of the block */

 delete_record;
 first_record; 

 /* set the insert allowed and delete allowed properties to false */

 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);

 set_item_property('ctrl_blk.show_term',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk.remove',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: INITIALISE_WINDOWS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
BEGIN
 /* Y2K check is done Edwin 06/21/99 */

 --:global.program_version := '2.03.00';
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.01';
 :global.action:=null;
 --:global.program_version := '02';
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- Added by Touqeer to incorporate Four digit of SSN Dated: 09/12/08
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- IM 2569
 --:global.program_version := '05'; -- Display SSN 4 or 9 Digits
 --:global.program_version := '06'; -- Replaced 'WAD' to :global.chapter_id
 --:global.program_version := '07'; -- IM 4712 Replaced chapter id with 'ALL' in don_inter procedure call
 --:global.program_version := '08'; -- IM 5408, IM 5464
 --:global.program_version := '09'; -- IM 5464
 --:global.program_version := '10'; -- Term Attributes not showing on screen; 05/26/2011;
 --:global.program_version := '11'; -- fix oracle error
 --:global.program_version := '12'; -- IM:8497
 --:global.program_version := '13'; -- SCR 20277 (Added columns ORIGINATED_FROM, REASON_CODE, GROUP_ID, GROUP_MODE to EXIST_INTER_BLK block)
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 -- :global.program_version := '01';
 -- :global.program_version := '02'; -- MLT-4414
 :global.program_version := '03'; -- MLT-8036
 
 --default_value('WAD','global.chapter_id');
 default_value(:global.chapter_id,'global.chapter_id');
 :GLOBAL.last_name := null;
 :GLOBAL.first_name := null;
 :GLOBAL.dob := null;
 :GLOBAL.s_sex := null;
 :GLOBAL.area_code := null;
 :GLOBAL.phone := null;
 :GLOBAL.s_address := null;
 :GLOBAL.city := null;
 :GLOBAL.state := null;
 :GLOBAL.zip := null;
 :GLOBAL.alter_id := null;
 
 :system.message_level :='10';

PROCEDURE check_terminated IS
 cnt number :=0;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_time1 date;
 v_local_date date;
 v_local_date1 date;
begin 
 if is_timezone_enabled then 
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 
 else
 v_local_date := trunc(sysdate);
 
 end if; 
 -- :exist_inter_blk.term_date:=trunc(v_local_date1);
 select count(*)
 into cnt
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id=:ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 and term_date< trunc(v_local_date);
 
 if cnt=0 then
 if get_item_property('ctrl_blk.show_term',ENABLED)='TRUE' then
 item_change('ctrl_blk.show_term','D');
 end if;
 else
 if get_item_property('ctrl_blk.show_term',ENABLED)='FALSE' then
 item_change('ctrl_blk.show_term','E');
 end if;
 end if;

 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 c_status varchar2(250):= 'OK';
 c_insert_date date;
 szChapter varchar2(5);
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 p_inter_type varchar2(5);
begin

 If IS_MULTI_CHAPTER then
 szChapter:='ALL';
 Else
 szChapter:=:global.chapter_id;
 End If; 
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then 
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:exist_inter_blk.insert_date,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := :exist_inter_blk.insert_date;
 
 end if; 
 c_insert_date:= trunc(:exist_inter_blk.insert_date);
 -- c_insert_date:= trunc(v_local_date);
 :system.message_level := '25';
 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 first_record;
 loop
 -- message(':exist_inter_blk.inter_code'||' '||:exist_inter_blk.inter_code);pause;
 
 if :exist_inter_blk.inter_code is not null then
 if :exist_inter_blk.rem = 'Y' then
 commit;
 -- c_insert_date := null;
 
 -- get the inter type 
 begin
 select inter_type into p_inter_type from valid_interdictions where inter_code=:exist_inter_blk.inter_code and rownum=1;
 exception when others then 
 null;
 end;
 
 If p_inter_type in ('INFOR','DR' ) then 
 
 don_inter.inter_upgrade_remove(:ctrl_blk.donor_id,
 szChapter,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :exist_inter_blk.inter_code,
 --NULL, -- Commented by Kishore on 08/01/2014. SCR 20277
 :exist_inter_blk.originated_from, -- Added by Kishore on 08/01/2014. SCR 20277
 --NULL, -- Commented by Kishore on 08/01/2014. SCR 20277
 :exist_inter_blk.reason_code, -- Added by Kishore on 08/01/2014. SCR 20277
 :banner.user_id,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.prog_name,
 trunc(:exist_inter_blk.eff_date),--trunc(sysdate),
 c_insert_date,
 nvl(:exist_inter_blk.term_date,sysdate),
 null,
 null,
 c_status); 
 
 if c_status!='OK' then
 
 message('Error:'||c_status);
 pause;
 end if;
 
 Else
 update donor_interdictions set term_date=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.term_date,sysdate) where
 donor_id=:ctrl_blk.donor_id and inter_code=:exist_inter_blk.inter_code and inter_type=p_inter_type;
 End if;
 
 end if;
 -- else
 
 -- null;
 end if; 
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 
 exit;
 end if; 
 
 next_record;
 end loop;

 commit;
 :system.message_level :='10';
 
end;
